Inspired by The 'Fat Acceptance' Contract post, I figured it would be good to lay it all out. Suggestions welcome!

The Shitlord contract:

I, _____________, being of sound mind and body, hereby declare that I will be better than I am now.

  • I shall acquaint myself with my body and all of its potential, its capability, and its actual limitations.
  • I will take pride in my appearance and be both hygenic and well dressed.
  • I will be active to the extent of my ability and well nourished through a moderate and balanced diet.
  • I will monitor my health and listen to medical professionals whose knowledge surpasses mine.
  • I will strive to educate myself about issues that touch my life, whether they affect me directly or not, before I form my opinion or attempt to teach others.
  • I will not attempt to cherry pick facts that support an unsubstantiated claim. I will be accepting of all factual data supported by properly designed scientific studies.
  • I will not scoff at information new to me simply because it makes me uncomfortable. I will embrace fact as I embrace water: essential.
  • I will never make excuses for failing to achieve my goals, I will only use failure as motivation to work harder.
  • I will recognize that for any disability or condition affecting me, there are always methods of dealing with the issues they present, and there is no excuse for allowing them to make me fat.
  • I recognize that if I am unable to use a tool created for the majority of the population, it is not because of oppression.
  • I understand that BMI is not meant to be used as the only measure of "fatness", but that dismissing it as "bullshit" is more detrimental than embracing it exclusively.
  • I recognize that past performance is not always a reliable indicator of future results. Just because I am healthy now does not mean that bad habits cannot catch up with me.
  • I will ensure to the best of my ability that my friends and family are not ignorant of what it means to be healthy, nor how to achieve it.
  • I understand that only I am in control of my life and must deal with the consequences of my choices.
  • I understand that my choices affect others, both directly and as a result of my own state. Being healthy makes everything easier for others, and society as a whole.

  • No Fatties

    It is with this contract that I aspire to an impressive, fulfilling life of awareness, happiness, and self-improvement.
